title: MogDop's Optimize
description: A mod pack based on game optimization.
body:
This modpack is focused on maximum performance, stability, and smooth gameplay. It includes the most essential and well-tested optimization mods that significantly improve FPS, reduce lag, and speed up world loading — all while keeping the vanilla Minecraft experience intact.

## ⚙️ Key Features:

- Noticeably improved performance, even on low-end PCs
- Reduced CPU and GPU load
- Faster world and server loading times
- Fixes for many internal Minecraft performance issues

## 🎮 Full Compatibility:

- Works on any server (vanilla and modded)
- Does not provide gameplay advantages, making it safe for multiplayer
- Suitable for both singleplayer and multiplayer gameplay
